Live Two-Way Google Sheet Sync

Connects this dashboard to a small Google Apps Script backend bound to your NAPHS Google Sheet. Once connected: every time this dashboard is opened it pulls the full current sheet — new Core Capacity Areas, indicators and activities appear automatically, no manual rebuild needed — and every activity you save here is written straight back to the matching row in the Sheet. Ask Claude for the backend script and deployment steps if this isn't set up yet.
